name: G.H2 Production via HTE-SOEC (w/o O2 co-product credit)
notes:
Publication Details
Elgowainy, A.;  Frank, E. D.;  Vyawahare, P.;  Ng, C.;  Bafana, A.;  Burnham, A.;  Sun, P.;  Cai, H.;  Lee, U.;  Reddi, K.; Wang, M. Hydrogen Life-Cycle Analysis in Support of Clean Hydrogen Production; Argonne National Laboratory; United States, ANL/ESIA-22/2, 2022, https://doi.org/10.2172/1892005

Notes: 
1. Electrolyzer embodied emissions are not included by default. To include embodied emissions, go to "Simulation Parameters"> Electrolyzer Tab> "With or without electrolyzer embodied emissions"  table> and put 1 in the "Option for Embodied Emissions".

2. The smaller electricity share is equivalent electricity share from Thermal energy input in SOEC. The equivalent electricity from thermal energy is calculated by assumng 33% steam turbine efficiency. The group efficiency calculation example and electricity share and thermal equivalent electricity share calculation is provided below.

Electricity Input to SOEC = X [J/kg H2]
Themal Energy Input = Y [J/kg H2]
Equivalent Electricity = (33/100)*Y = 0.33*Y [J/kg H2]

Efficiency = LHV H2/(X+0.33*Y)
Electricity SOEC Share = X/(X+0.33*Y)
Thermal Equivalent Electricity Share = 0.33*Y/(X+0.33*Y)

Zhou, X.; Pandey, I.;  Vyawahare, P.;  Ng, C. Updated Water Consumption Factors of Hydrogen Production Pathways; Argonne National Laboratory; United States, ANL/ESIA, 2024, https://greet.anl.gov/publication-wcf_updates_2024
